definitions.explanation: Publishing a story, manga, or article in installments over successive issues of a magazine, newspaper, or online platform.

examples.japanese: この{漫画|まんが}は{週刊誌|しゅうかんし}で{連載|れんさい}されている。
examples.english: This manga is serialized in a weekly magazine.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{作品|さくひん}の{連載|れんさい}が{終了|しゅうりょう}した。
examples.english: The serialization of the popular work has ended.

examples.japanese: {新聞|しんぶん}に{小説|しょうせつ}を{連載|れんさい}していた{作家|さっか}が、{単行本|たんこうぼん}として{出版|しゅっぱん}することになった。
examples.english: The author who had been serializing a novel in the newspaper decided to publish it as a standalone book.

notes:
A key word in manga and publishing culture. Many famous Japanese manga and novels were first published as serializations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {連載|れんさい}する (to serialize)
- {連載|れんさい}{開始|かいし} (start of serialization)
- {連載|れんさい}{終了|しゅうりょう} (end of serialization)
- {連載|れんさい}{中|ちゅう} (currently serialized)
- {連載|れんさい}{漫画|まんが} (serialized manga)
- {連載|れんさい}を{休|やす}む (take a break from serialization — hiatus)

In manga culture, a {連載|れんさい} ending is a major event. The term {打|う}ち{切|き}り refers to a serialization being cancelled, while {完結|かんけつ} means a planned conclusion.
